units.source_text: 却说这位年轻的英雄，不去注意他的崇拜者，而更多地注意起我来。

en.t: Now this young hero paid no attention to his admirers, but began to pay more attention to me.

units.source_text: 在他看来，仿佛谁有我不低于他的威风，这样的感觉伤害了他的自豪感。

en.t: To him, it seemed as though someone like me possessed an imposing presence no less than his own, and that feeling wounded his pride.

units.source_text: 他向大家打听了我的名字，然后向初次见面的我相呼道：

en.t: He asked everyone what my name was, and then called out to me, though we had only just met:
